referenceTargetPaletteProvenance: Exact target palette sampled from the live MT5 reference chart; it is not an observation about dev-before screenshots.
captureLimitations: The emulator state is captured only at the real canonical BTCUSD/M5 default viewport.
Native pinch automation is intentionally not claimed: remaining timeframe and zoom rows are deterministic metadata fixtures with no screenshot path.
Development entries preserve the pre-light-parity screenshot state. Their observed colors are not sampled or inferred from the reference target palette.
commitPolicy: No task commit is created: the shared checkout is dirty and predominantly untracked, so an isolated baseline commit is unsafe.

goldenMatrix.fixture: Deterministic BTCUSD OHLC, fixed UTC clock, one position line, one-click panel visible, and min/default/max viewport clamps.
